title: 深度 MLP 與自動編碼器

stages.title: 系統邊界與基本原理
stages.description: 在深度 MLP 與自動編碼器案例中比較MLP weight與bias與非線性與latent瓶頸，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate mlp weights/biases and nonlinearity/latent bottleneck within the Deep MLP and autoencoder case.

steps.title: 全連接層與參數：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Dense layers and parameters: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對MLP weight與bias提出可反駁的全連接層與參數模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable dense layers and parameters model and evidence record for mlp weights/biases.
steps.instruction: 在「深度 MLP 與自動編碼器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識MLP weight與bias。單層y=Wx+b的參數數是輸入×輸出加輸出bias；權重共享假設需另列。 建立全連接層與參數的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是全連接層、非線性與潛在瓶頸重建。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。對兩層小MLP逐矩陣核對參數及輸出shape。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify mlp weights/biases in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Deep MLP and autoencoder. For y=Wx+b, parameters equal input times output plus output bias; shared weights need separate specification. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of dense layers and parameters, focusing on dense layers, nonlinearities and latent-bottleneck reconstruction. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Check each parameter matrix and output shape in a small two-layer MLP. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 對兩層小MLP逐矩陣核對參數及輸出shape。
steps.observationEn: Check each parameter matrix and output shape in a small two-layer MLP.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：一層參數數永遠只等於神經元數。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Layer parameters always equal neuron count.
steps.check: 提交MLP weight與bias的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for mlp weights/biases.

knowledge.title: 全連接層與參數
knowledge.text: 單層y=Wx+b的參數數是輸入×輸出加輸出bias；權重共享假設需另列。 本課架構對應：MLP weight與bias
knowledge.textEn: For y=Wx+b, parameters equal input times output plus output bias; shared weights need separate specification. Course architecture correspondence: MLP weights/biases

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 對兩層小MLP逐矩陣核對參數及輸出shape。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；一層參數數永遠只等於神經元數。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Check each parameter matrix and output shape in a small two-layer MLP. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: Layer parameters always equal neuron count.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設MLP架構32→8→32，每層含bias：encoder有32×8+8=264參數，decoder有8×32+32=288，總552。線性瓶頸最多秩8；非線性增加表達能力但不保證泛化，重建loss不能代替任務驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Assume MLP 32→8→32 with bias: encoder 264 parameters, decoder 288, total 552. A linear bottleneck has rank at most 8; nonlinear expression does not guarantee generalization, and reconstruction loss does not replace task validation.

quiz.question: 就MLP weight與bias的「全連接層與參數」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for dense layers and parameters in mlp weights/biases?
options: 單層y=Wx+b的參數數是輸入×輸出加輸出bias；權重共享假設需另列。
一層參數數永遠只等於神經元數。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: For y=Wx+b, parameters equal input times output plus output bias; shared weights need separate specification.
Layer parameters always equal neuron count.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
quiz.explanation: 單層y=Wx+b的參數數是輸入×輸出加輸出bias；權重共享假設需另列。 對兩層小MLP逐矩陣核對參數及輸出shape。
quiz.explanationEn: For y=Wx+b, parameters equal input times output plus output bias; shared weights need separate specification. Check each parameter matrix and output shape in a small two-layer MLP.

steps.title: 全連接層與參數：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Dense layers and parameters: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對MLP weight與bias提出可反駁的全連接層與參數模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable dense layers and parameters model and evidence record for mlp weights/biases.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「全連接層與參數」模型，檢查MLP weight與bias的兩個假想案例。對兩層小MLP逐矩陣核對參數及輸出shape。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分單層y=Wx+b的參數數是輸入×輸出加輸出bias；權重共享假設需另列。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous dense layers and parameters model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving mlp weights/biases. Check each parameter matrix and output shape in a small two-layer MLP. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "For y=Wx+b, parameters equal input times output plus output bias; shared weights need separate specification." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 對兩層小MLP逐矩陣核對參數及輸出shape。
steps.observationEn: Check each parameter matrix and output shape in a small two-layer MLP.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：一層參數數永遠只等於神經元數。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Layer parameters always equal neuron count.
steps.check: 提交MLP weight與bias的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for mlp weights/biases.

steps.title: 線性瓶頸與非線性：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Linear bottlenecks and nonlinearities: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對非線性與latent瓶頸提出可反駁的線性瓶頸與非線性模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable linear bottlenecks and nonlinearities model and evidence record for nonlinearity/latent bottleneck.
steps.instruction: 在「深度 MLP 與自動編碼器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識非線性與latent瓶頸。線性encoder-decoder組合的秩受瓶頸限制；非線性改變表達但不保證保留任務資訊。 建立線性瓶頸與非線性的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是全連接層、非線性與潛在瓶頸重建。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。用低秩矩陣與非線性小例比較可重建資訊。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify nonlinearity/latent bottleneck in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Deep MLP and autoencoder. A linear encoder-decoder has bottleneck-limited rank; nonlinearity changes expression without ensuring task information survives. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of linear bottlenecks and nonlinearities, focusing on dense layers, nonlinearities and latent-bottleneck reconstruction. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare recoverable information in low-rank and nonlinear examples. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 用低秩矩陣與非線性小例比較可重建資訊。
steps.observationEn: Compare recoverable information in low-rank and nonlinear examples.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：增加非線性必然重建所有輸入且無損失。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Nonlinearity necessarily reconstructs every input losslessly.
steps.check: 提交非線性與latent瓶頸的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for nonlinearity/latent bottleneck.

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界

knowledge.textEn: Compare recoverable information in low-rank and nonlinear examples. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: Nonlinearity necessarily reconstructs every input losslessly.

quiz.question: 就非線性與latent瓶頸的「線性瓶頸與非線性」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for linear bottlenecks and nonlinearities in nonlinearity/latent bottleneck?
options: 增加非線性必然重建所有輸入且無損失。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。

optionsEn: Nonlinearity necessarily reconstructs every input losslessly.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
A linear encoder-decoder has bottleneck-limited rank; nonlinearity changes expression without ensuring task information survives.
quiz.explanation: 線性encoder-decoder組合的秩受瓶頸限制；非線性改變表達但不保證保留任務資訊。 用低秩矩陣與非線性小例比較可重建資訊。
quiz.explanationEn: A linear encoder-decoder has bottleneck-limited rank; nonlinearity changes expression without ensuring task information survives. Compare recoverable information in low-rank and nonlinear examples.

stages.title: 功能架構與量化模型
stages.description: 在深度 MLP 與自動編碼器案例中比較encoder-decoder梯度與全連接參數與activation，各完成分析及驗證。

steps.title: 重建與任務效用：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Reconstruction and task utility: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對encoder-decoder梯度提出可反駁的重建與任務效用模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable reconstruction and task utility model and evidence record for encoder-decoder gradients.
steps.instruction: 在「深度 MLP 與自動編碼器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識encoder-decoder梯度。低重建誤差可能保留背景而忽略小但關鍵訊號；latent表徵需用獨立任務驗證。 建立重建與任務效用的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是全連接層、非線性與潛在瓶頸重建。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。構造相同平均重建誤差但不同關鍵訊號保留的兩案例。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify encoder-decoder gradients in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Deep MLP and autoencoder. Low reconstruction error may preserve background but omit small critical signals; validate latents on independent tasks. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of reconstruction and task utility, focusing on dense layers, nonlinearities and latent-bottleneck reconstruction. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Construct equal-mean-error cases with different critical-signal preservation. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 構造相同平均重建誤差但不同關鍵訊號保留的兩案例。
steps.observationEn: Construct equal-mean-error cases with different critical-signal preservation.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：重建誤差低就證明所有下游任務最佳。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Low reconstruction error proves optimality for every downstream task.
steps.check: 提交encoder-decoder梯度的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for encoder-decoder gradients.

knowledge.text: 假設MLP架構32→8→32，每層含bias：encoder有32×8+8=264參數，decoder有8×32+32=288，總552。線性瓶頸最多秩8；非線性增加表達能力但不保證泛化，重建loss不能代替任務驗證。

steps.title: 失效分析與泛化：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Failure analysis and generalization: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對潛在維度與失效提出可反駁的失效分析與泛化模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable failure analysis and generalization model and evidence record for latent dimensions/failure.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「失效分析與泛化」模型，檢查潛在維度與失效的兩個假想案例。比較分組誤差、校準與未見情境表現。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分平均指標可掩蓋少數類與分佈漂移；模型信心不等於正確率。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous failure analysis and generalization model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving latent dimensions/failure. Compare grouped errors, calibration and withheld scenarios. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Means hide minority classes and distribution shifts; confidence is not correctness." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 比較分組誤差、校準與未見情境表現。
steps.observationEn: Compare grouped errors, calibration and withheld scenarios.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：高confidence就足以認定答案正確。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: High confidence establishes correctness.
steps.check: 提交潛在維度與失效的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for latent dimensions/failure.

knowledge.textEn: Compare grouped errors, calibration and withheld scenarios. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: High confidence establishes correctness.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設MLP架構32→8→32，每層含bias：encoder有32×8+8=264參數，decoder有8×32+32=288，總552。線性瓶頸最多秩8；非線性增加表達能力但不保證泛化，重建loss不能代替任務驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Assume MLP 32→8→32 with bias: encoder 264 parameters, decoder 288, total 552. A linear bottleneck has rank at most 8; nonlinear expression does not guarantee generalization, and reconstruction loss does not replace task validation.
